The Green Party is in receipt of donations to support legal costs in two legal actions in which I am named as a party. Both legal cases date back to the period when I was Co-Leader of the Green Party. The legal proceedings do not concern my personal rights or liabilities, I do not personally receive any donations and the Green Party has agreed to fully indemnify me for any charges and expenses.

synopsis: Adrian Ramsay is the Green Party MP for Waveney Valley, and has been an MP continually since 4 July 2024. He currently undertakes the roles of Green Spokesperson (Health), Green Spokesperson (Dentistry), and Green Spokesperson (Environment, Food and Rural Affairs).
